detail: Committed project status, not a live check of the engine you are using. Registry-profile features (Trial) are deployed in the team's Chalk environment and served by the online query triallens_registry_profile; the registry profile line on each trial shows whether this engine reached it. The verifier evaluation trialforge-verifier ran on Chalk Compute (39 rows, 0 task errors; data/chalk_eval_run.json). The investigator evaluation protocolos-investigator has run locally only (evals/investigator/results.json). Model mode uses the Chalk Model Gateway and needs a router key; the public deploy runs without model keys, so model mode is off there (see the LLM chip).
